# signoz_auth_domain (Data Source)

Reads a single auth domain by `id` or by unique `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by domain name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
# Required/optional comments follow provider schema and SigNoz OpenAPI / Alertmanager where applicable.

data "signoz_auth_domain" "saml" {
  name = "saml.example.com" # required (lookup; exactly one of id or name)
}

output "auth_domain_id" {
  value = data.signoz_auth_domain.saml.id # read-only
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup.
- `name` (String) Object name (unique within the organization for that resource type). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set for lookup.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String, Sensitive) JSON auth domain configuration (`AuthtypesAuthDomainConfig`): `ssoEnabled`, and one of `samlConfig`, `oidcConfig`, or `googleAuthConfig`, plus optional `roleMapping`. Default: omitted (empty object sent when unset). Sensitive.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
